mapping_notes: This is a community Hugging Face checkpoint fine-tuned from nvidia/mit-b5 on IDD 20K.
Only exact source labels in the checkpoint id2label are mapped into SPIN-UV labels.
The public IDD L2 checkpoint reports 16 labels and does not expose exact car or wall metrics in its model card; car and wall are therefore excluded for this IDD row.
IDD autorickshaw, motorcycle, rider, truck, curb, fence, billboard, parking, and rail track are outside this row's comparison set.
The IDD motorcycle label is not mapped to SPIN-UV scooter.
This row uses a 7-label exact overlap: building, road, sky, sidewalk, vegetation, pole, person.
